quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Ge Haiquan (H1 2026 results briefing): its existing MOCVD tools run in a flexible shared-line mode supplying capacity for both the telecom and datacom markets; as datacom customer demand keeps growing, and under its medium- to long-term capacity expansion plan, the company has placed purchase orders for additional MOCVD equipment. Delivery timing depends on the equipment makers' production scheduling and lead times and is uncertain; once installed, debugged and process-validated the tools go straight into mass production. He said 400mW CW products have reached small-batch shipments and capacity build-out is proceeding to support their scaled delivery.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing, answers to pre-collected questions): order backlog is ample; it has an FAU product line in small-batch shipments and will raise capacity to match market and customer demand; 400mW CW products are delivered in small batches while sampling and qualification continue at several customers; 1.6T AWG, 400mW CW DFB and 100G EML are key products in customer validation. Asked about on-chip WDM with micro-ring modulators versus discrete AWG, it said technology routes are still evolving and no route's outlook can be judged with certainty, but it expects WDM applications in data-center interconnect to widen as AI compute drives the datacom market.
